datasets.geography: 43 territories; 39 country-level keys and 4 mapped UK subnational keys
limitations: Winter colony loss is not a direct reproductive endpoint.
No apiary-level RF dosimetry, varroa, pathogen, pesticide, forage, or weather covariates are held.
Methods and temporal coverage differ across territories.

datasets.endpoint: 72 semen endpoint rows plus 20 cryptorchidism rows
limitations: Figure-digitized values from one breeding programme; no matched human panel or RF dosimetry.
The 1999–2001 source gap is artificial and is not imputed.

datasets.geography: 17 national series plus EUR supranational aggregate
limitations: Abundance is not a reproductive endpoint; index definitions and sampling intervals vary.
No matched site-level RF dosimetry is held.
Held series is reconstructed, lacks study-row provenance/uncertainty, and is not promoted to an observed row-level panel.
The held livestock JSON contains citations and qualitative descriptions, not numeric observation rows.

scope_boundary: BLOCKED is a data-readiness state, not an evidence score or causal conclusion.
The artifact does not convert mobile subscriptions or qualitative exposure ranks into RF dosimetry.

tests.reason: One dog SITE cannot form a regional or multi-country matched dog–human panel; the held human sperm series is reconstructed and excluded.
requirements: Matched regional dog and observed human biomarker time series
tests.title: Dog-to-human lag

tests.reason: There is no matched regional dog–human biomarker panel with social covariates at the same geography and time resolution.
requirements: Matched dog and observed human biomarker panel
tests.title: Dog biology versus social covariates

tests.reason: No numeric bull or boar observation rows are held; the livestock file is qualitative citation metadata only.
tests.title: Bull negative control

tests.reason: No species environment has measured RF dosimetry, and no numeric livestock response panel is held.
requirements: RF dosimetry for dog and bull/boar environments
tests.title: Measured exposure gradient

tests.reason: Dog data cover one SITE only, so a regional lag distribution and CV cannot be estimated.
tests.title: Cross-region lag invariance

tests.reason: No matched region-year chemical exposure and RF dose panel is held for the sentinel records.
tests.title: Chemical discrimination

withdrawn_records.reason: The stored bee lag output uses sparse, mixed-method winter-loss data and an unvalidated calendar-time lag method; it is not a forecast.
The stored bird lag output uses irregular abundance-index samples and an unvalidated calendar-time lag method; it is not a forecast.
The stored sperm lag output depends on a reconstructed human proxy series and an unvalidated calendar-time lag method; it is not a forecast.
